verdict.rationale: uv installs Python and switches between versions (uv-docs-6, uv-docs-27). `uv python pin` writes a checked-in `.python-version` file for the project (uv-gh-1), and that pin is respected in CI (uv-docs-50); community users report it replacing pyenv (uv-comm-6, uv-comm-15). missing for 10: runtime management limited to Python with no other languages, tool versions are pinned only via CLI (`uvx ruff@0.6.0`) rather than a project config file, and no explicit evidence that `uv run` auto-installs the pinned interpreter.
